info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Open Banking Event-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation of events within the Open Banking framework, facilitating secure and standardized communication between financial institutions and third-party providers. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can initiate specific banking events that trigger subsequent consumer actions, enhancing customer interactions and service delivery. Targeted primarily at financial institutions and fintech developers, the API streamlines event management and compliance with Open Banking regulations, fostering innovation in digital banking solutions.
